wfcore.debug.drill_scan.on: Drill scan debug: ON (yellow=head, red=ore in range, green=vein centre)
wfcore.machine.radar.name: Radar
wfcore.machine.radar.tooltip:
Finds enemy bases by clustering nearby machines and players.
Needs sky access and Y >= 100.
Requires EV power and computation from a Mainframe (via a Computation Reception Hatch).
wfcore.machine.printer.tooltip: Prints a written report of bases found in radar scan data.
wfcore.machine.vehicle_factory.tooltip:
Assembles a vehicle and deploys it in front of the factory.
Recipes are programmable (KubeJS); the recipe's output item is the vehicle.
wfcore.machine.large_transformer.tooltip:
Redistributes DC EU from input hatches to output dynamos, which re-emit at their own voltage.
Optionally converts to/from AC EU (coolant-cooled) for long-distance transmission via AC Input/Output hatches.
wfcore.machine.mainframe.tooltip:
Provides computation (CWU/t) to research units and radars.
CPUs supply compute, RAM caps throughput, coolers fight heat.
Output it through a Computation Transmission Hatch.
wfcore.machine.copper_heatsink.tooltip1: §9Passive cooler.§r Vents the mainframe's heat to the surrounding air; no coolant needed.
wfcore.machine.copper_heatsink.tooltip2: Removes more heat the further the mainframe runs above the ambient temperature.
wfcore.machine.copper_heatsink.tooltip3: §eAttach a Cooling Fan Cover§r (LV–EV) to its outward face to multiply its cooling several times over.
wfcore.machine.copper_heatsink.tooltip4: §7Weakest on its own; stack several heatsinks or add fan covers for meaningful cooling.
wfcore.machine.cooling_liquid.tooltip1: §bActive cooler.§r Pumps the mainframe's coolant (up to §e100 mB/t§r each) to shed heat quickly.
wfcore.machine.cooling_liquid.tooltip2: Colder coolants carry more heat: §fWater§r < §bOxygen§r < §bHelium§r < §bLiquid Nitrogen§r.
wfcore.machine.cooling_liquid.tooltip3: §7Needs a coolant supply via a fluid input hatch; far stronger than passive fans.
wfcore.machine.mv_network_switch.tooltip:
§bBridges optical computation networks.§r
Pools every attached Computation Reception Hatch and re-serves the combined CWU/t out of every Transmission Hatch.
Lets several Mainframes share their computation, or fans one Mainframe's output out to many machines.
§7Chain multiple switches together to extend the network further.
Draws §e%s EU/t§r per connected computation hatch.
wfcore.machine.research_unit.tooltip:
Runs research using materials, power and computation.
Completed research is written to a data stick.
wfcore.machine.large_blast_furnace.toolt: Smelts iron into §emolten steel§r. Feed iron and coal dust through item buses; draw liquid steel from a fluid output hatch and slag from an item bus.
§6Central chamber§r processes §e2 recipes at once§r, twice as fast as a basic primitive furnace.
Add a §eBronze Firebox§r side chimney on the left and/or right: §e+2 recipes§r each, capping at §e6 at once§r.
§7More chambers burn proportionally more fuel, but each also trims the duration slightly. Byproduct: tiny Dark Ash slag.
wfcore.machine.chunk_reinforcer.tooltip1: §eBurns food to reinforce your faction's nearby claimed chunks against sieges.
wfcore.machine.chunk_reinforcer.tooltip2: Reinforces claims within %s chunk(s) for +%s siege defence while fuelled.
wfcore.gui.transformer.no_sink: §cAC output not connected to a destination§r
wfcore.machine.drill_rig.tooltip:
Drills the bedrock deposit beneath its drill head.
The deposit type selects the recipe.
Each cycle drains the connected cluster from its outer blocks inward until only the central block is left, then it is exhausted and turns to bedrock.
Feed a drilling fluid through a fluid input hatch to mine faster, gain byproducts, or extract deposits that need it.
wfcore.machine.gas_extractor.tooltip:
Collects gases from the atmosphere.
Set a §eProgrammed Circuit§r in an Item Input Bus to choose which gas to collect.
Also processes item and fluid inputs, and outputs both items and fluids.
wfcore.machine.drill_rig.no_deposit: No ore deposit found below drill head
wfcore.gui.research.title: Research Tree
wfcore.gui.research.info_unformed_desc: This controller isn't part of a complete Research Unit. Assemble the full 3x3x3 multiblock exactly and it forms automatically.
wfcore.gui.research.info_part_computatio: • Computation Data Reception Hatch (wired to a Mainframe)
wfcore.gui.research.info_part_data: • Optical Data Transmission Hatch (optional; wire a Data Bank to sync research)
wfcore.gui.research.info_hint_preview: Tip: sneak + right-click with an empty hand to preview the structure in-world.
wfcore.gui.research.info_slave_desc: This unit is in Slave mode. It lends one parallel research slot to any Control unit sharing its computation network (both reception hatches wired to the same optical pipes) and doesn't run research itself.
wfcore.gui.research.info_slave_hint: Tip: wire its Computation Reception Hatch to the Control's network with optical pipes, or use a screwdriver to switch it back to Control mode.
wfcore.gui.research.slave_mode: Slave mode: lends a parallel slot to a Control unit on the same computation network
wfcore.gui.research.write_hint: Writes the selected research onto the data item or paper in the slot
wfcore.gui.research.read_hint: Imports every blueprint written on the data item in the slot into this unit's database
wfcore.gui.research.in_data_bank: Stored on a connected Data Bank
wfcore.gui.research.tip_cancel: §7Click to cancel; banked progress is kept
wfcore.gui.research.blocker_queue_full: Research queue is full (%s). Remove one to start another.

wfcore.tooltip.cooling_fan_cover.line2: Multiplies that heatsink's passive cooling to about §b%s×§r a bare heatsink (%s tier).

wfcore.tooltip.mining_charge: Cube blast that mines only natural blocks (ores, stone, dirt) and keeps their drops. Inert to fire; set off with a Detonator.
wfcore.tooltip.mining_charge.tier: Depth tier: %s (1 = surface, 2 = deepslate, tuff & deep ores)
wfcore.tooltip.detonator.hint: Sneak + right-click a charge to link; right-click to detonate
wfcore.tool.siege_tester.tooltip: Right-click to sample this chunk's WarForge siege difficulty.
wfcore.machine.missile_factory.tooltip:
Assembles missiles into its core storage; they are far too large to carry.
Shift-click with a Data Stick to copy this factory's position, then click a Missile Launch Silo to link it.
wfcore.machine.missile_launcher.tooltip:
Fires missiles drawn from linked Missile Factories at dialed-in coordinates.
Link factories with a Data Stick; shift-click with one to clear links.
wfcore.machine.interceptor.tooltip:
Automatically shoots down incoming hostile missiles with interceptors drawn from linked Missile Factories.
Link factories with a Data Stick; shift-click with one to clear links.
wfcore.gui.interceptor.no_links: Link a Missile Factory with a Data Stick
wfcore.gui.interceptor.mode_auto_tip: Auto best-fit: sizes the interceptor to each incoming missile, saving premium rounds for the threats that need them.
wfcore.gui.interceptor.mode_manual_tip: Manual: fires only the interceptor type selected below.
wfcore.gui.launcher.y_hint: Detonation height. Leave on auto to strike the surface.
wfcore.gui.launcher.y_auto: Reset Y to auto (surface height at launch)
wfcore.gui.launcher.status_no_missile: No missile available in linked factories
wfcore.gui.launcher.attack_profile_tip: Auto uses the missile preset's default. Speed preserves momentum, Balanced trades speed for alignment, and Loft gives the missile the most room to turn. Left/right click to cycle.
wfcore.gui.launcher.attack_direction_tip: The side of the target where the missile should line up for its final approach. Auto uses the direct route. Left/right click to cycle.
wfcore.gui.launcher.approach_distance_ti: Maximum distance from the target at which the missile starts joining the selected final approach, in blocks.
wfcore.gui.launcher.map_hint: Click to target, drag to pan
wfcore.gui.launcher.no_links: Link factories with a Data Stick
wfcore.gui.launcher.link_out_of_range: Factory is out of range (max %s blocks)
wfcore.gui.launcher.link_invalid: That block is not a Missile Factory
wfcore.gui.launcher.link_no_data: No factory position on this Data Stick (shift-click a Missile Factory first)
wfcore.machine.missile_factory.link_copi: Factory position (%s, %s, %s) saved to Data Stick
wfcore.gui.launcher.no_warforge: Install WarForge for the target map
wfcore.machine.primitive_alloyer.tooltip: A primitive melting furnace: burns fuel to melt and alloy metals. Consumes no power.
Fuel: Lava (10 mb/t from a fluid input hatch) or any burnable solid fuel (coal, charcoal, coke...) from the input bus, not wood or planks.
Runs out of fuel? The recipe pauses until fuel is supplied again.
wfcore.machine.primitive_alloyer.no_fuel: Out of fuel (needs Lava or solid fuel)
wfcore.machine.strandcaster.tooltip1: Casts molten alloys into solid ingots. Consumes no power or fuel.
wfcore.machine.strandcaster.tooltip2: Casts a batch of 16 ingots from 2304 mb of molten alloy in 6s.
wfcore.machine.strandcaster.tooltip3: Supply Water (20 mb/t) to a coolant hatch to cast twice as fast (3s).
